name: Cursor
description: Cursor is an AI-first code editor, built as a fork of VS Code, that adds agentic coding features like autonomous multi-file edits, predictive AI autocomplete, and chat grounded in a codebase's own context.
best_for: Individual developers and engineering teams who want an AI-native desktop editor capable of autonomous, multi-file coding tasks, with access to multiple frontier models rather than being locked to one provider.
features: Agent mode for autonomous, end-to-end coding tasks, including building, testing, and preparing changes for review, that can run in parallel across repositories
Tab, a predictive AI autocomplete that suggests multi-line edits rather than single completions

Composer, Cursor's own in-house frontier coding model, alongside access to third-party frontier models from Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (GPT), Google (Gemini), and xAI (Grok), with automatic model selection
Codebase indexing and semantic search so the AI can ground suggestions in a project's actual code
An 'autonomy slider' for controlling how independently the AI acts, from small targeted edits to fully autonomous runs
Cloud Agents for running coding tasks outside the local machine
Bugbot for automated code review on pull requests
CLI installation for terminal-based usage alongside the desktop editor
pros: Free Hobby tier gives real access to Composer and limited Agent use before paying anything
Access to multiple frontier model providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI) plus Cursor's own Composer model in one editor
Built on VS Code, so existing extensions, themes, and keybindings mostly carry over
cons: All paid plans meter AI usage — even Pro can incur additional on-demand charges once the plan's included usage allowance runs out
No official web or mobile version; Cursor is a desktop application only

tiers.name: Hobby
tiers.notes: Free. Limited Agent requests and access to Composer; no credit card required.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Includes $20 of model usage; on-demand usage billed in arrears beyond that allowance.

tiers.name: Pro+
tiers.notes: Includes $70 of model usage, roughly 3x Pro's Agent limits.

tiers.name: Ultra
tiers.notes: Includes $400 of model usage, roughly 20x Pro's Agent limits, plus priority access to new features.

tiers.name: Teams (Standard)
tiers.notes: Adds centralized billing, a team marketplace, shared context/agents, usage analytics, privacy mode, and SAML/OIDC SSO.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Custom pricing. Adds pooled usage, invoice/PO billing, SCIM, advanced access controls, and audit logs.

alternatives.name: GitHub Copilot
alternatives.description: GitHub and Microsoft's AI pair programmer, available as an extension inside existing editors like VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, and Neovim.
alternatives.best_for: Teams who want AI code completion and chat inside the editor they already use, rather than switching to a dedicated AI-first editor.

alternatives.name: Replit
alternatives.description: A cloud-based IDE with an AI agent that can build, run, and host full applications from natural-language prompts, without local setup.
alternatives.best_for: Builders who want to go from idea to a deployed, hosted app entirely in the browser, rather than working in a local desktop editor.
strengths: Cloud IDE with built-in hosting and database
AI Agent builds and deploys full apps, not just code snippets

faq.question: Is Cursor free?
faq.answer: Cursor has a free Hobby plan with limited Agent requests and access to Composer. Paid plans start at $20/month (Pro) for a larger usage allowance, with on-demand billing once that allowance is used.

faq.question: Which AI models does Cursor support?
faq.answer: Cursor gives access to multiple frontier models, including Anthropic's Claude, OpenAI's GPT, Google's Gemini, and xAI's Grok, plus Cursor's own in-house Composer model, with an automatic model-selection option.

faq.question: What's the difference between Cursor's Pro, Pro+, and Ultra plans?
faq.answer: They differ mainly in included usage: Pro includes $20/month of model usage for $20/month, Pro+ includes $70 of usage (about 3x Pro's Agent limits) for $60/month, and Ultra includes $400 of usage (about 20x Pro's limits) for $200/month.
